_doc: Task 6K.1 section 11. Frozen Task 6J J1 samples re-attributed against the native vector map: was the supervision target a single native building or part of a pseudo-instance merge, and did it have a clean YOLO proposal?

interpretation.ambiguous_or_inseparable: No single native building corresponds to the target, so the failure cannot be attributed with the current evidence.
interpretation.proposal_model_error_against_clean_vecto: The target is exactly one native building and a YOLO proposal at IoU >= 0.5 existed, so the failure is in the proposal/executor chain rather than in the instance definition.
interpretation.pseudo_label_definition_error: The supervision target is itself a pseudo-instance covering >= 2 native buildings, so 'the largest/leftmost building' is ambiguous between them.
interpretation.representation_mismatch: The target is one native building but no proposal reached IoU 0.5: proposal or representation mismatch.
